scope: Read-only audit of restored candidate169 production source and previously verified current public181 artifact evidence. No changes to production source, camera/device state, or publication.

current_public.meaning: Published181 adds a synthetic inference test. Candidate169 P010, HDR beauty, and URI save integration are not installed. Existing1.7.9 photography is preserved; neither all-mode JPEG removal nor HDR beauty completion is established.

device_access.conclusion: No accessible Android device connection identified in this execution environment. This does not assert that the users physical phone is disconnected elsewhere. No device command or hardware operation was performed.

entry_and_provider_blockers.finding: installProcessor rejects while candidate gate is false; session requires processor and application context.
PlanProvider is an interface. Production-source search found no implementation, no new CaptureProcessor169 instance, and no installation call.

NativeBindingProvider is an interface with no production implementation. Same-shot crop/mask, native draw order, calibrated shader sampling, full style bindings and resolved settings are required inputs, not acquired automatically by this coordinator.
Actual original native/composer restoration verification is caller-supplied; successful start callback/status/handle is explicitly insufficient.
Native mutation observer/private transform exists but is not installed; all-state coverage and native queue barrier providers remain unimplemented. ReplayPlan.UNAVAILABLE rejects authorization.

mode_coverage.candidate: Callable but gated/uninstalled; exact pinned recorder/callback chain only. Requires trusted plan/native/restoration providers before first actual photo.
Owned requests explicitly fail. There is one global in-flight choice and one State submitted request; no multi-photo joining/processing/completion queue.
Owned capture rejects request.isReprocess(). Existing input configuration is copied unchanged at session creation, but this does not implement a trusted HDR reprocess source.
prepare explicitly rejects automatic-save=false. Adapter bypasses original Bitmap holder only for owned auto-save shots; no HDR URI editor/manual-save integration exists.
Owned request sets frame source0, force-preview=false, screenshot-after-failure=false. This disables fallback but does not implement HDR preview/screenshot replacement.

mode_coverage.mode: video snapshot / active recording / alternative recorder
mode_coverage.candidate: Only exact TECameraVideoRecorder backend accepted; paused analysis requires recorder status2 (preview, not recording). No active-video HDR still integration demonstrated.
Session bridge accepts regular Camera2 sessions only, normal stream map only, SENSOR_PIXEL_MODE_DEFAULT forced. No alternate-session path implemented.

Logical/selected physical route metadata and HLG support are checked. Exact preview+P010 session must pass isSessionConfigurationSupported and actual returned dataspace/result must match. No lens has actual device validation; advertised per-format capacity alone is not success.

hook_scope.integration_warning: Old transform hash-pins released165 runtime/method payload. It cannot be applied as a replacement on181; any eventual integration needs method-level rebasing on latest published payload with unrelated app/runtime preservation.

grounded_work_remaining: Implement a real PlanProvider backed by complete observed same-shot settings and measured initialization/restoration/native queue receipts, then a NativeBindingProvider that consumes actual same-shot native crop/masks/sampler/order/full-style data. Recovered models alone do not supply these values.

For burst, implement an explicit bounded per-request photo queue with independent image/result ownership, captured settings, dimensions and URI outcomes; merely deleting the current rejection would corrupt the one-shot state design.

For reprocess modes, either implement a validated HDR-capable source and session or route the app request through a fresh supported P010 still with matching app semantics. Never convert an8-bit reprocess source and label it preserved10-bit HDR.

Manual-save/editor requires a newly integrated HDR-aware document/source and operation pipeline. There is no verified shortcut that makes the existing Bitmap UI preserve the requested full HDR process.
Rebase new hooks against current181 effective methods; retain all intervening focus/lens/save/chroma changes and unrelated integrated app patches.

Run actual SM-S948Q capture/result/data-space, model binding/restoration, output decode/gain-map reconstruction and UI save checks for each supported lens/mode; no device run can be substituted by existing host checks.
technical_limits: Supplied SM-S948Q public-format inventory exposes no native5712x4284 candidate. With the currently exposed4080x3060-or-smaller input, app-only no-upscale24.5MP capture is not achievable through that exposed route. This does not establish all future firmware/vendor routes as impossible.

The ability to acquire P010/HLG is advertised, not proof that the exact retained preview plus physical still session works. Closed-SDK bindings/restoration and device codecs remain unverified; this audit cannot honestly promise full completion.
No new complete MPP should be published by flipping CandidateGate169 or by providing synthetic/default providers.
